Here is what you're looking for Previous All General Design Performance Health What's the Best Next What makes Galaxy Watch Ultra2 worth the upgrade? Galaxy Watch Ultra2 offers significant upgrades such as a larger battery, brighter display and rugged durability for those who push further and expect more from their watch. Battery: An 800 mAh battery with fast charging means longer workout sessions and less time on a charger. , Display: The 1.52-inch screen reaches up to 5,000 nits, sharp and vivid enough to read clearly even in direct sunlight environments. Durability: The titanium body delivers premium strength, backed by IP69K and 10 ATM ratings that handle everything from heavy rain to recreational diving in the open water. Outdoor Experience: Dedicated workout tracking for activities such as trail running, cycling and diving gives you the specific data and guidance you need for each activity. What connectivity options does Galaxy Watch Ultra2 support? Galaxy Watch Ultra2 supports both LTE and Bluetooth, along with Wi-Fi (2.4 GHz and 5 GHz), dual GPS (L1+L5) and NFC. These options provide reliable pairing with your smartphone, fast data transfer, precise location tracking, contactless payments and independent cellular service. You can stay connected and track activities even when your phone is not nearby. LTE availability depends on your country/region and carrier. , , Which colors are available for Galaxy Watch Ultra2? Galaxy Watch Ultra2 is available in Titanium Silver and Titanium Gray. What's new about Galaxy Watch Ultra2? Galaxy Watch Ultra2 integrates the iconic cushion design, screen and bezel into one unified form, so the watch looks and feels like a single solid piece. The seamless design reduces visual fragmentation, giving Galaxy Watch Ultra2 a balanced, premium finish. What is the Air Pocket structure and how does it improve comfort? The Air Pocket design is a contoured inner surface on the Marine Band that lets sweat dry and water drain naturally. This reduces friction between the band and your skin, keeping the watch comfortable during long wear whether you're on a trail run, in the water or just going about your day. What's new with the buttons on Galaxy Watch Ultra2? Galaxy Watch Ultra2 features three bold, distinctly spaced buttons, designed to be more intuitive by feel. Enhanced tactile separation and an orange accent of the Quick Button make each button distinct, letting you navigate the watch quickly, even with gloves on. What is the battery capacity of Galaxy Watch Ultra2 and how fast does it charge? Galaxy Watch Ultra2 is equipped with an 800 mAh battery, offering the largest battery on a Galaxy Watch. You get up to 60 hours of usage with AOD on and with the first Fast Charging on a Galaxy Watch, you get 40 % battery in just 30 minutes. Despite the larger battery, Galaxy Watch Ultra2 is actually slimmer than Galaxy Watch Ultra, so you get more power with less size. , , How large is the screen of Galaxy Watch Ultra2? Is it bright enough to stay visible outdoors? Galaxy Watch Ultra2 features a 1.52-inch display with 5,000 nits of brightness, the brightest ever on a Galaxy Watch. Your pace, route or heart rate stays clearly visible even in direct sunlight, so you can check your data at a glance whether you're on a trail run or coming up from a dive.4axy Watch. Is Galaxy Watch Ultra2's titanium body tough enough for scratches and impacts during outdoor activities? Galaxy Watch Ultra2's titanium body is built to take impact head-on while staying light on your wrist, so it moves naturally with you during extended wear. It resists scratches, dents and wear without adding bulk, giving you confidence on rugged terrain. Is Galaxy Watch Ultra2 waterproof and dustproof? Galaxy Watch Ultra2 is built to handle the toughest outdoor conditions, supported by multiple durability certifications. IP69K: Resistant to dust and high-pressure, high-temperature water jets. 10 ATM: Handles deep water immersion up to 10 atmospheres. MIL-STD-810H: Certified for resistance to extreme environmental conditions including temperature extremes, shock, vibration and humidity. EN13319: Internationally recognised standard for diving instruments, making Galaxy Watch Ultra2 the first Galaxy Watch to meet this standard. Can I wear the Galaxy Watch Ultra2 while swimming in a pool or in the ocean? Yes. With 10 ATM water resistance and EN13319 certification, Galaxy Watch Ultra2 is built for the water. You can wear it confidently while swimming or diving in the pool or open water, down to 40 meters. , Does Galaxy Watch Ultra2 have GPS? Galaxy Watch Ultra2 has built-in GPS for real-time position tracking and GPX files support to load and follow pre-planned routes, turn by turn, so you're always on track. GPS runs for up to 20 hours and GPX for up to 16 hours*, giving you plenty of battery life for extended trail runs. , *Based on GPX usage with power saving mode (Standard) enabled during exercise. What features in Galaxy Watch Ultra2 are available for trail runs? Here are some key features that enhance your trail run experience on Galaxy Watch Ultra2 Route: Load a GPX file and follow your pre-planned course turn by turn, with GPS tracking your position in real time. Climb Guidance: Check your average gradient and elevation gain ahead of each segment, so you can manage your pace before the hill slows you down. Water Intake Alarm: Get timely reminders on how much water to drink and when, so you stay hydrated even when the trail has your full attention. What depth does the Galaxy Watch Ultra2 support for dive tracking? What does it track during a dive? Galaxy Watch Ultra2 tracks your current depth, elapsed dive time and water temperature in real time, helping you stay aware of the changing conditions underwater down to 40 meters. How does Galaxy Watch Ultra2 track my cycling activity? Galaxy Watch Ultra2 connects directly to your external cycling sensors without your phone in between, so you can see cadence, power and speed alongside your heart rate right on your wrist. Just keep your eyes on the road and push for your personal best. How do I activate the SOS siren on the Galaxy Watch Ultra2? To activate the SOS siren, press and hold the Quick Button for 5 seconds. This triggers a powerful siren audible from up to 180 meters away, at up to 86 decibels. Use it to attract attention quickly whenever you need help outdoors or in an emergency. , What is the Energy Score on the Galaxy Watch Ultra2? Energy Score is a daily readiness rating generated each morning based on your recent activity, sleep patterns and overnight heart signals. Check the score breakdown to see whether today calls for a hard session or a smart recovery, with Galaxy AI guiding your decision. How does Sleep Coaching help improve my sleep quality? Sleep Coaching is a personalized program that helps you build better sleep habits over time. Wear Galaxy Watch Ultra2 for a week to uncover your sleep type, represented as one of eight animals. Then, follow a 3 to 4 week program of simple, incremental changes designed to improve your sleep quality night after night. How does Galaxy Watch Ultra2 detect and alert me to sleep apnea?
